title: Account Registration
key_learnings: Keep HTTP decoding and response mapping at the transport boundary
Put reusable registration decisions behind a non-HTTP operation
Define interfaces around the behavior a consumer needs
Use errors.Is-compatible errors so callers can map failures
mistakes: The first submission did not directly test the new non-HTTP service entry point
The separate Has and Save calls are not atomic under concurrent registration
review_changes: Added direct service coverage proving registration works without HTTP
validation: source-reviewed; Go toolchain unavailable in automation runtime

title: Gift Card Redemption
key_learnings: Related state changes need one owner and one atomic boundary
A mutex per method does not protect a workflow spanning several method calls
Failure-path tests should assert every affected piece of state
Recheck mutable state inside the operation that commits the change
mistakes: The first submission did not test that a failed credit leaves the card unredeemed
The service supplied the credit amount even though the store owned the authoritative card value
review_changes: Moved card lookup, amount selection, redemption, and credit under one store lock
Added a regression test proving credit failure leaves the card unchanged
